devdoc.details: Graph Proxy contract used to delegate call implementation contracts and support upgrades. This contract should NOT define storage as it is managed by GraphProxyStorage. This contract implements a proxy that is upgradeable by an admin. https://docs.openzeppelin.com/upgrades-plugins/1.x/proxies#transparent-proxies-and-function-clashes

params.data: Calldata (including selector) for the function to delegatecall into the implementation

admin().details: NOTE: Only the admin and implementation can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103`

returns._0: The address of the current admin

implementation().details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc`

returns._0: The address of the current implementation for this proxy

pendingImplementation().details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0x9e5eddc59e0b171f57125ab86bee043d9128098c3a6b9adb4f2e86333c2f6f8c`

returns._0: The address of the current pending implementation for this proxy

setAdmin(address).details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function.

upgradeTo(address).details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function.

devdoc.title: Graph Proxy

acceptUpgrade().notice: Admin function for new implementation to accept its role as implementation.

acceptUpgradeAndCall(bytes).notice: Admin function for new implementation to accept its role as implementation, calling a function on the new implementation.

setAdmin(address).notice: Changes the admin of the proxy.

upgradeTo(address).notice: Upgrades to a new implementation contract.

devdoc.details: Produce epochs based on a number of blocks to coordinate contracts in the protocol.

params._data: Calldata for the initialization function call (including selector)

currentEpoch().details: Return the current epoch, it may have not been run yet.

returns._0: The current epoch based on epoch length

currentEpochBlock().details: Return block where the current epoch started.

returns._0: The block number when the current epoch started

currentEpochBlockSinceStart().details: Return the number of blocks that passed since current epoch started.

returns._0: Blocks that passed since start of epoch

epochsSince(uint256).details: Return the number of epoch that passed since another epoch.

params._epoch: Epoch to use as since epoch value

returns._0: Number of epochs and current epoch

epochsSinceUpdate().details: Return number of epochs passed since last epoch length update.

returns._0: The number of epoch that passed since last epoch length update

isCurrentEpochRun().details: Return true if the current epoch has already run.

returns._0: Return true if current epoch is the last epoch that has run

runEpoch().details: Run a new epoch, should be called once at the start of any epoch.

syncAllContracts().details: This function will cache all the contracts using the latest addresses Anyone can call the function whenever a Proxy contract change in the controller to ensure the protocol is using the latest version

devdoc.title: EpochManager contract

ContractSynced(bytes32,address).notice: Emitted when contract with `nameHash` is synced to `contractAddress`.

ParameterUpdated(string).notice: Emitted when a contract parameter has been updated

SetController(address).notice: Emitted when the controller address has been set

acceptProxy(address).notice: Accept to be an implementation of proxy.

acceptProxyAndCall(address,bytes).notice: Accept to be an implementation of proxy and then call a function from the new implementation as specified by `_data`, which should be an encoded function call. This is useful to initialize new storage variables in the proxied contract.

controller().notice: Controller that contract is registered with

runEpoch().notice: Perform state changes for the current epoch

setController(address).notice: Set Controller. Only callable by current controller.

syncAllContracts().notice: Sync protocol contract addresses from the Controller registry
